content: I umeqqran n imeɣnajen. S teɣnint n ‘Talillect d acehhad’. Tira ineqcen n Dawud i useřmed.
X řami tuɣa ittmenɣa ak-d imezdaɣ n Aram-Nahrayn, aqa-tt d Misuputamya, u ak-d ayt n Aram zi Ṣuba, umi dd-idweř Yuwab, iwta ayt n Idum di teɣzurt n Tmeǧaḥt, ɛecra ařaf n yeryazen.
A AREBBI, Cek tenḍareḍ aneɣ, tarẓid aneɣ. Tuɣa tesɛared aṭṭas! Sbedd aneɣ ɛawed!
Cek tessenhezzed tammurt, tfeǧqed tt. Sgenfa tireẓẓa nnes, maɣar aqa tᵉttenhezza.
Cek tessecned Ixef nnec i řgens nnec s řeqsaḥet. Cek tewcid aneɣ ad nsu ccrab issdewwaxen.
Inni Cek itteggʷeden, teggid asen taɛeǧant i ɣar ttrakkwařen zi fřitcat n řqews. Silah.
Ḥima imɛizzen nnec ad ttwafekken, awi asenjem s ufus afusi nnec u arr-dd xaneɣ.
AREBBI tuɣa issawař di Zzawect nnes Iqeddsen, s uyenni ad negzeɣ s řefraḥet. Necc ad bḍiɣ Cakim, ad ɛebbareɣ taɣzurt n Sukkut.
Jilɛad inu, Manassa inu, Ifrayim d aseřqi ijehden n uzeǧif inu, Yahuda d amgewwed inu.
Mu’ab d ssarij inu i usird, x Idum ad nḍareɣ sandaliyat inu, necc ad dduqzeɣ s usřiwřew x temmurt n Filicit.
Wi d ayi i ɣa inedhen di tendint ifaryen? Wi d ayi ɣa igewwden ɣar Idum?
Ma war d aneɣ tenḍared, a, AREBBI, u ak-d řɛeskarat nneɣ ma war akidsen dd-teffiɣed ɛad, a AREBBI?
Ewc aneɣ afus ḥima ad aneɣ tessnejmed zi řeḥṣaret, maɣar asenjem s ufus n yijj n bnadem aqa-t baṭeř.
Ak-d AREBBI ad negg s wemḥad, Netta ad iɛfes x yinni d aneɣ iḥeṣṣaren.

footnotes.text: Talillect- ict n marka n nnuwarat daysen aẓri aṭṭas.
